name.ja: 30MS オプションボディパーツ アームパーツ&レッグパーツ[カラーC]
name.en: 30MS Optional Body Parts Arm Parts & Leg Parts [Color C]

description.ja: 30MS素体との組み合わせで世界観が広がる！手、腕、足、首、無塗装フェイスパーツがセットになったオプションパーツがラインアップ！
description.en: The world view expands when combined with the 30MS body! A lineup of optional parts includes hands, arms, legs, neck, and unpainted face parts!

description.ja: ■成形色パターンは「「30MS SIS-A00 ルルチェ[カラーC]」(別売り)と同様の[カラーC]。
description.en: • The molding color pattern is [Color C], which is the same as "30MS SIS-A00 Lurche [Color C]" (sold separately).

description.ja: ■表情豊かなハンドパーツと腕部・脚部パーツが付属。
description.en: • Includes expressive hand parts, arm and leg parts.

description.ja: ■「左右の可動」「前後の可動」を実現する可動方向の異なる首パーツが2種付属。
description.en: • Two types of neck parts with different movable directions are included to achieve "left and right movement " and " front and back movement."

description.ja: ■無塗装状態のフェイスパーツが付属し、キャラメイキングの幅が更に拡大！「30 MINUTES SISTERS 水転写式デカール 汎用1」(別売り)との組み合わせで表情豊かなキャラメイキングを実現！
description.en: • Unpainted face parts are included, further expanding the range of character creation! In combination with "30 MINUTES SISTERS Water Transfer Decal General Purpose 1" (sold separately), you can create expressive characters!

accessories.ja: 無塗装フェイスパーツ×1式
